title: Line sketch: Leaping Hares in Moonlight
description: Black-and-white ink line sketch on white paper — pure contour and edge drawing with no color fills. Edge-traced line art of: Two hares bound mid-leap across a backdrop scattered with abstract leaves, circles, and a large floral-patterned orb. Overlapping figures and partial rabbits at the edges create rhythmic motion and depth. Flat color blocks with minimal shading define a clean, graphic approach (derived from painting #121).
